milestones.name: Defeat Poltergate (split forms)
milestones.note: Poltergate splits into two forms; one drops from above, one attacks horizontally. Clear standard enemies in early phase first.

milestones.name: Defeat Sol Vin
milestones.note: Penultimate challenge before final boss. Floor shrinks then disappears entirely in final phase. Use Hairpin to stay airborne.

milestones.name: Defeat The Keeper of the Heart
milestones.note: Final boss. Longest fight in the game. Uses jabs, projectiles, and slams. Attack after slam recoveries.

milestones.name: Defeat Shii
milestones.note: True ending boss. Combines elements from every previous fight. Requires specific true ending path.

milestones.name: Game completion
milestones.note: Awarded upon defeating The Keeper of the Heart.

milestones.name: True ending
milestones.note: Awarded upon defeating Shii on the true ending path.

zones.name: Late-game story progression

zones.name: End of main story
zones.note: Location of The Keeper of the Heart, the final boss.

zones.name: True ending path
zones.note: Requires specific true ending path; location of Shii.

abilities.name: Hairpin
abilities.grants: Stay airborne during Sol Vin's final phase when floor disappears
abilities.note: Required for survival in Sol Vin final phase.

abilities.name: Protective Overlay Modifier
abilities.grants: Maximum coating layers for survivability in long fights
abilities.note: Recommended for The Keeper of the Heart and Shii. Equip for maximum coating layers.

abilities.name: Kinetic Thrust Modifier
abilities.grants: Aggressive damage output for players who can avoid damage consistently

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.note: Required by Acat; core mechanic emphasized in boss guide summary.

abilities.name: Sail
abilities.note: Benefits Atmos greatly; core mechanic emphasized in boss guide summary.

bosses.name: Poltergate
bosses.note: Splits into two forms mid-fight. One drops from above (aerial dive), one attacks horizontally. Early phase spawns standard enemies — clear them first. Split attention required.

bosses.name: Sol Vin
bosses.note: Penultimate boss. Twin mechanics: one swings, one slams. Floor shrinks to central circle early, then disappears entirely. Use Hairpin to stay airborne in final phase. Difficulty: ★★★★☆.

bosses.name: The Keeper of the Heart
bosses.note: Final boss. Massive health pool. Uses jabs, projectiles, and slams. Attack after slam recoveries. Equip Protective Overlay Modifier. Difficulty: ★★★★★.

bosses.name: Shii
bosses.note: True ending boss. Combines elements from all previous bosses. Requires mastery of all abilities and pattern recognition. Keep protective coatings maxed. Difficulty: ★★★★★.

bosses.name: Calderon
bosses.note: Second phase considered among the hardest in the game by most players.
